issues.title: Add Form Validation to Notification Page
issues.description:
#### **User Story** * **As a** Notification Manager, * **I want** the "Confirm Notification" button to be disabled until I've filled out all necessary fields, and I want a clear indicator of which fields are required, * **so that** I can avoid submission errors and understand exactly what information is needed to send a notification. --- #### **Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin Format)** **Scenario 1: Initial Page Load** * **Given** a Notification Manager is on the "Send Notification" page, * **When** the page finishes loading, * **Then** the "Confirm Notification" button **must** be in a disabled state. * **And** a required field indicator (e.g., a red asterisk `*`) **must** be displayed next to the labels for required fields. **Scenario 2: User Completes All Required Fields** * **Given** the "Confirm Notification" button is disabled, * **When** the user provides valid input for all required fields, * **Then** the "Confirm Notification" button **must** transition to an enabled state. **Scenario 3: User Clears a Required Field After Completion** * **Given** all required fields are filled and the "Confirm Notification" button is enabled, * **When** the user deletes the content from a required field (e.g., clears the "To" field), * **Then** the "Confirm Notification" button **must** immediately transition back to a disabled state. --- #### **Test Cases** | Test ID | Description | Steps | Expected Result | |---------|-------------|-------|-----------------| | **TC-001** | **Initial State:** Verify the button is disabled and indicators are present on page load. | 1\. Navigate to the "Send Notification" page. | The "Confirm Notification" button is greyed out and unclickable. An asterisk `*` is visible next to the four required field labels. | | **TC-002** | **Partial Completion:** Verify the button remains disabled if not all required fields are filled. | 1\. Select a "Notification Type".
2. Select "Recipients".
3. Enter a "Subject". | The "Confirm Notification" button remains in its disabled state because the "Message" field is empty. | | **TC-003** | **Full Completion:** Verify the button becomes enabled once all required fields are filled. | 1\. Perform steps from TC-002.
2. Enter text into the "Message" field. | As soon as text is entered into the "Message" field, the "Confirm Notification" button becomes active and clickable. | | **TC-004** | **Re-Disabling:** Verify the button disables if a required field (e.g., Recipients) is cleared. | 1\. Complete all steps from TC-003 so the button is enabled.
2. Clear the "Recipients" selection. | The "Confirm Notification" button immediately returns to its disabled state. | | **TC-005** | **UI/UX Verification:** Confirm the visual states of the button are distinct. | 1\. Observe the "Confirm Notification" button in both disabled and enabled states. | There is a clear and unambiguous visual difference (e.g., color, opacity, cursor style) between the two states. |

issues.title: Enable Register Button on Form Completion
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** new user registering for ORBIT,
* **I want** the "Register" button to activate only after I have provided all the required information,
* **so that** I have a clear visual cue that my form is ready to be submitted and can avoid validation errors.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin Format)**

**Scenario 1: Page Loads for the First Time**

* **Given** a new user is on the self-registration page,
* **When** the page finishes loading,
* **Then** the "Register" button **must** be in a disabled state (e.g., visually greyed-out and not clickable).

**Scenario 2: User Completes All Required Fields**

* **Given** the "Register" button is disabled,
* **When** the user enters valid data into the final required field on the form,
* **Then** the "Register" button **must** transition to an enabled state (e.g., full color and clickable).

**Scenario 3: User Clears a Required Field After Completion**

* **Given** all required fields are filled and the "Register" button is enabled,
* **When** the user deletes the content from any one of the required fields (e.g., clears the "Rank" selection),
* **Then** the "Register" button **must** immediately transition back to a disabled state.

---

#### **Test Cases**

| Test ID | Description | Steps | Expected Result |
|---------|-------------|-------|-----------------|
| **TC-001** | **Initial State:** Verify the button is disabled on page load. | 1\. Navigate to the self-registration page. | The "Register" button is greyed out and cannot be clicked. |
| **TC-002** | **Partial Completion:** Verify the button remains disabled if not all required fields are filled. | 1\. Navigate to the registration page. 2. Fill in the "SSN" and "Rank" fields. | The "Register" button remains in its disabled state. |
| **TC-003** | **Full Completion:** Verify the button becomes enabled once all required fields are filled. | 1\. Navigate to the registration page. 2. Fill in all required fields (e.g., SSN, Rank, Organization, Phone Number) with valid data. | As soon as the last required field is filled, the "Register" button becomes active and clickable. |
| **TC-004** | **Re-Disabling:** Verify the button disables if a required field is cleared. | 1\. Complete all steps from TC-003 so the button is enabled. 2. Delete the value from the "Phone Number" field. | The "Register" button immediately returns to its disabled state. |
| **TC-005** | **UI/UX Verification:** Confirm the visual states are distinct. | 1\. Observe the "Register" button in both disabled and enabled states. | There is a clear and unambiguous visual difference (e.g., color, opacity, cursor style) between the two states. |

issues.title: Send Notifications to Government Issued Mobile Device
issues.description:
see 1107 

As a ORBIT user who has a Government Issued mobile device and who has entered the number for the Government issued mobile device on my ORBIT profile, I want to receive SMS notifications at that number whenever I meet the criteria for an SMS notification that is sent by my organization.

---

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:

* If a user has entered a valid phone number in the "Government Issued Mobile Device" field of their profile, when a Notification Manager sends an SMS notification with conditions that the user meets, the user receives an SMS notification at the number entered in the "Government Issued Mobile Device" field.
* If a user has entered a separate number in the Notification Information section of their profile, they also receive the notification at that number.

issues.title: Profile Update Date in Sql
issues.description:
previous item 852 had 2 issues:

1. george.b. miller16.ctr updated his profile and had a dateupdatedbyemployee in sql. I then went in and updated his employee record. It wiped out the dateupdatedbyemployee. It should have no impact on that field when updated from the employee screen.
2. I updated my profile and it updated the dateupdatedbyemployee correctly. I then went in and updated my employee record (not profile). It changed the dateupdatedbyemployee date. Updating anyone's record from the employee screen should have no impact on that field.
